question: The value of {(6 + 4) + (12 ÷ 4 × 2)} + 1{1 over 3} × 9 ÷ 3 + 1 {2 over3} is:
solution:
Concept:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dfa37dd92516dac70db5949544836cfe4f28a07b23d5655750740f4c850504ca.png] 

 

**Solution:**

⇒ {(6 + 4) + (12 ÷ 4 × 2)} + 1(1)/(3) × 9 ÷ 3 + 1(2)/(3)

⇒ {10 + 6} + 4/3 × 9 ÷ 3 + 5/3

⇒ {16} + 12 ÷ 3 + 5/3

⇒ {16} + 4 + 5/3

⇒ 20 + 5/3

⇒ ​​65 over 3

**Therefore, the value of the given expression is 65 over 3.**
